items.html: *Behold, after there was an upper coupling of Arich Anpin in his Hochma and Bina, and the male drop was included within the female drop, and it was the aspect of two times 42, as mentioned, for these are the revealed ones, as mentioned — behold, afterward this drop descended to the Yesod of Arich Anpin himself, and we now find that in the Yesod of Arich Anpin there are two times: 42, 42.
